key_insight: CurvDelta steers model updates into low-curvature directions of the preservation loss, enabling targeted learning or unlearning while limiting degradation of existing capabilities.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a geometry-aware way to adapt LLMs when acquiring or removing specific capabilities must not compromise general performance.
method: Construct a low-curvature update space from the local geometry of the preservation loss around the original model.
Use Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and factorized projection to make the construction scalable.
Apply CurvLoRA for low-rank adaptation within the same preservation geometry.
evidence_signal: Evaluations cover mathematical reasoning, code generation, and TOFU/MUSE knowledge unlearning, reporting improved acquisition–retention or forgetting–retention trade-offs, with unlearning retention close to from-scratch retraining.
watch_item: Preservation relies on local, approximate curvature estimates; the abstract does not quantify computational overhead or robustness for large updates.
paper_title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
